empty.description: Boards that exist with no open jobs.

missing.description: Boards the ATS says don't exist.

private.description:
Boards with jobs that aren't for the public: internal, referral-only,
alumni or talent-community boards, and LinkedIn or third-party
mirrors of a main board, told by the board's name. Never ingested.

excluded.description: Known boards the first search was told to leave out, up to the engine's cap (Exa 1,200, Parallel 197): those earlier searches returned, newest first, then live boards with the most jobs. Each query also leaves out what the ones before it found.

skipped.description: Queries an earlier run sent, not sent again (`again` sends them).

description: One `loker discover` run: boards found, then unchecked and due boards asked about.

boards.description: Every board loker knows, by status; `failed` counts unchecked boards whose last check got no answer.

checked.description: Boards asked about in this run (new ones and re-checks), by what their ATS answered now; `failed` got no answer and is asked again next run.

costUsd.description: What the search engine said the searches cost, in US dollars; only Exa says.

errors.description: The first failures: searches that got no answer, then board checks.

new.description: Of those, boards loker did not know before.

search.description: For `exa` and `parallel`: the queries sent and skipped, and the known boards left out.

skipped.description: The crawl was read before, so only checking ran (`again` reads it anew).

unreadable.description: URLs or lines that name no board.

title: DiscoverReport
